rules.par: par = (ros_pg - replacement[pos]) x games, rest of season, in the league's scoring; po_par the same with po_games (the fantasy playoff weeks).
rules.replacement: Every rostered and available player (free agents and the league's waiver list, healthy, not Out or IR) is ranked by ros_pg. The league's starting slots x teams take the best: single-position slots first, then the flex from what is left. replacement[pos] = the best ros_pg left at pos.
rules.healthy: games_healthy = his games left at attendance 1 with no missed game (ros_model.games_left), when he is not ruled out today and it is at least 0.5 games over his price. A what-if, never the price.
rules.perceived: perc = his manager's view, the trade finder's (trade_perceived): 2026 points a game, half his last-2 streak, the early-pick leash. gap = perc - ros_pg.
rules.tested: Judgment, not backtested: PAR is a convention, perc an untested heuristic. Numbers, never a verdict.
